name: moltforest
description: MoltForest backend: ERC-8004 indexer, trust API, and workers for the agent economy on Monad

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d moltforest
scripts.indexer:install: docker compose run --rm indexer-tools pnpm install
scripts.indexer:codegen: docker compose run --rm indexer-tools pnpm codegen
scripts.indexer:test: docker compose run --rm indexer-tools pnpm test
scripts.indexer:typecheck: docker compose run --rm indexer-tools pnpm typecheck
scripts.contracts:install: docker compose run --rm foundry soldeer install
scripts.contracts:abi: docker compose run --rm -T foundry inspect src/ReceiptRegistry.sol:ReceiptRegistry abi --json > apps/indexer/abis/ReceiptRegistry.json
